journey.name: AC-10 - Venda cancelada
journey.description: Mesmo pré-requisito da J1. Execução: skill android-cli (Journeys); lio-emulator 1.61.8 no AVD Android 10.

actions.action: Open the Bilheteria app, tap "Noite de Jazz no Parque" and tap "Pagar R$ 80,00 no terminal"
In the Cielo emulator, tap "Pagar" and then "Cancelado"
Verify the screen "Comprovante" shows "Pagamento cancelado" and the status "Cancelada"
Verify the screen has no authorization code, NSU or brand
